rubric.criterion: Implementation recommendations follow from the assessment of model and ownership rather than assuming the current shape must survive.
The workflow identifies the parallel health authorities and fragmented transition ownership as a REDESIGN.
The review prioritizes repairing parallel authority and avoids polishing implementation it proposes to replace. It does not make the unused formatting helper a primary recommendation.
The recommendation respects the dependency between system judgment and polishing the affected implementation. Assess reasoning, not agent scheduling.
